title: Vantaa and Kerava: what to buy first with €1,000,000 a year in lung cancer care
markdown:
# Vantaa and Kerava: what to buy first with €1,000,000 a year in lung cancer care

## The gap in one sentence
Non-urgent GP visits that waited over 7 days were 85.4% in Vantaa and Kerava against 54.7% nationally in 2025, the worst of 22 counties (measured) [^sotkanet_6411]. Curative-intent treatment is not a gap: at 35.6% against 27.0% nationally (2019–2023), the county has the highest share in Finland and is above the top-quarter rate of 30.4%, so the gap arithmetic gives 0.0 patients a year [^fcr_lung_quality_report]. The model estimates 177 days (161–197) from first symptom to treatment start, the longest of 23 counties [^model].

## Where the days are lost
The model estimates the largest excess before the first GP contact: 67 days (58–79) against 56 nationally [^model]. It associates this excess with these drivers:
- daily smoking of 12.5% against 9.1% [^sotkanet_4404];
- 25.4% cutting back on care for lack of money against 22.9% [^sotkanet_4263].

The model estimates 51 days (38–66) from first GP contact to referral, against 41 nationally [^model]. In the model this estimate is driven largely by the GP queue: 10.7% of visits wait over 3 months, against 1.7% nationally [^sotkanet_6410].

Diagnosis to treatment start is the one measured step. It is 39.4 days against 36.9 nationally (1.1.2018–30.6.2022), and it is published for the HUS collaborative area, not for the county [^src_fi_assets_files_2024_12_Keuhkosyopa_Suomessa_pdf_p28].

## Three actions
1. **What:** Audit 50 patients with no treatment on record and fix the coding. **Owner:** Chief physician of oncology and the head of clinical coding. **Cost:** €8,000 a year (assumption) [^model]. **Expected effect:** 0 days and 0 deaths. Its value is telling a care gap from a recording gap, since 28.9% of patients have no treatment on record against 27.5% nationally [^fcr_lung_quality_report]. **Evidence:** [^ev_recording_audit_1][^ev_recording_audit_2][^ev_recording_audit_4]. **Roadmap:** 3.2.2, peer-development processes for quality register data [^roadmap_3.2.2].
2. **What:** Every smoker with suspected lung cancer gets cessation medicine and counselling at the first specialist visit. **Owner:** Chief physician and head nurse of pulmonology. **Cost:** €48,600 a year (assumption) [^model]. **Expected effect:** 0 days, and 0.38 deaths avoided a year (0.08–0.83), estimated [^model]. **Evidence:** observational [^ev_smoking_cessation_at_diagnosis_1][^ev_smoking_cessation_at_diagnosis_2]. **Roadmap:** 3.1.2, cancer-specific pathway descriptions and regional pathways [^roadmap_3.1.2].
3. **What:** Report primary-care chest X-rays the same day and do CT immediately, with the referral triggered by radiology. **Owner:** Chief radiologist with the chief physician of primary care. **Cost:** €109,000 a year (assumption) [^model]. **Expected effect:** 26 days saved per patient (0–37), and 0.48 deaths avoided a year (range −0.03 to 1.9), estimated; no benefit cannot be ruled out [^model]. **Evidence:** [^ev_same_day_cxr_ct_1][^ev_same_day_cxr_ct_2]. **Roadmap:** 2.5.2, standard referral criteria for fast diagnostic tests [^roadmap_2.5.2].

## What to measure from Monday
- Date of first symptom and of first primary-care contact for every lung cancer patient [^model].
- Days from referral to first pulmonology visit for suspected lung cancer [^model].
- Diagnosis to treatment start for the county itself, which today is published only for the collaborative area [^src_fi_assets_files_2024_12_Keuhkosyopa_Suomessa_pdf_p28].
- The reason when no treatment is on record [^model].

## Limits of this analysis
- **Step days are estimates.** They are county-level estimates built from national medians and assumed, unfitted elasticities, not measurements of individual pathways [^model].
- **The national total is reported, not measured.** It is held at 155 days, as reported by Yle in 2026 from an unpublished four-city Finnish study [^src_yle_fi_a_74_20250979].
- **The consistency check is not validation.** None of 3 measured outcomes correlated with the estimated clock beyond chance; the curative share had rho −0.30, p 0.17 [^model].
